meta.name: instagram-post-comments
meta.description: Fetches comments from an Instagram post including comment text, username, timestamp, like count and reply count. Use when user mentions Instagram comments scraping, get comments from Instagram post, Instagram comment list, pull Instagram comments, read Instagram comments, Instagram post discussion, extract Instagram comments, comment data from Instagram, IG post replies, who commented on Instagram.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取 Instagram 帖子的评论数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量获取 Instagram 帖子的评论信息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to collect comment data from Instagram posts

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以自动抓取指定 Instagram 帖子的评论，包括评论内容、用户名、时间、点赞数和回复数。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 获取 Instagram 帖子的评论，例如提到“拉取评论”、“查看评论列表”或“提取评论数据”时触发。

say.text: 帮我拉取这个 Instagram 帖子的所有评论。
say.note: Claude 会开始抓取评论并返回列表。

say.text: 看看谁评论了这条 Instagram 帖子。
say.note: Claude 会获取评论者用户名和内容。

say.text: 提取这条帖子的评论数据，包括点赞数和回复数。
say.note: Claude 会返回每条评论的详细信息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically fetch comments from a specified Instagram post, including comment text, username, timestamp, like count, and reply count.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to get Instagram post comments, such as mentioning "pull comments", "view comment list", or "extract comment data".

say_en.text: Fetch all comments from this Instagram post.
say_en.note: Claude will start scraping comments and return a list.

say_en.text: See who commented on this Instagram post.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve usernames and comment text.

say_en.text: Extract comment data for this post, including like and reply counts.
say_en.note: Claude will return detailed info for each comment.
